diagnosis: common cold (viral upper respiratory tract infection)
narrative: A 34-year-old woman presents to an urgent care clinic on day 2 of illness with sore throat, nasal congestion, rhinorrhea, and malaise. She has no chronic illnesses and takes no regular medications. At presentation her temperature was 37.9 °C and her blood pressure was 118/76 mmHg. Examination shows mild pharyngeal erythema without exudate. Lungs are clear.
